layers.name: Centerlines
layers.description: This is a representation of Benton County roads. Federal and State Highways and County roads were digitized by using a Global Positioning system. City streets were drawn by using aerial photography.The attribute table and its fields were designed and expanded on by following the AR State Centerline File Standard (ACF).
